title: Kill Bots Short Cuts
heading: Three lengths of Maddie's presentation
intro: The full version stays whatever happens: it is also 'the video Maddie left' for the website. These are the fallbacks (12 Nov). Pick the one you'd put in the film, and note anything (a line, a take, a moment). Nobody has listened to the new mint lines yet: you're the first ears.

sections.h: Which version goes in the film?
sections.lede: Whole scene A, street to street. The hologram is the middle stretch.

groups.title: Scene A: full, scissors-only, or brutal + mint
groups.line: Full = what's in the film now (round 25). Scissors = the same voice takes, trimmed, no new lines. Brutal + mint = new 'taste of mint' turn in Maddie's voice, harder cuts.

opts.label: Brutal + mint: scene 3:04, hologram 1:31 (new lines, unheard)
